hooks.command: jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty" | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.md|*.env.example|*ISSUE_TEMPLATE*|*pull_request_template*) out=$(python3 "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.github/scripts/check_docs.py" 2>&1) || { printf "%s\n" "$out" >&2; exit 2; };; esac; }
